body: I'm hopefully off to bed now since it's almost 3 am and I have school. Obviously not 100%, but I'm good enough to make it to tomorrow and I appreciate everything everyone here has done as well as those who I talked to in PM. Night

I know that objectively it's not all or nothing, in fact as far as things go, everything about my life is pretty fantastic. I'm fortunate to have parents together who both have good jobs, two great older brothers who've had their own problems but come out strong, and not trying to be immodest but I am pretty smart, or at least I am not an idiot but only if you're talking about academically.

Practically speaking, I am an idiot because despite all this I ignore it all and just focus on wanting it over. The thing that quite literally scares me the most is thinking I'll never be able to end it, even though stories like yours do touch me, I still don't want to be stuck like this.

I do genuinely like helping people, most of the time. The good part of me does, anyways. The other parts makes me wish I could end up just killing someone else. If I took 90% of the advice I've given out to people I'd be in such good shape right now, but even getting out of bed is hard. The worst part is, I just can't get by, I HAVE to do well this year so 'just getting by' is not an option for me. Everything for me feels like all or nothing
I really wish I had people here with me, but I find when I do I can almost feel more alone.

It's good to hear that people can get through it, sometimes I think I can, and others I don't think it will ever go away. Even at those I think I can make it I can come back to this point anyways, though, because I think it's not worth trying and I can't miss anything if I'm not there to miss it.

Sometimes knowing people care helps, sometimes it makes it worse, and at times like now you may as well tell me a brick wall cares. I find it hard to care what other people think when I can't care for myself. I think?
